title: Local LLM RPG
goal: Create a game-master system that can sustain context-rich dialogue, quests and world state inside Unreal Engine 5.
action: Built a persistent WebSocket bridge and local Python backend with retrieval-augmented generation, per-NPC memory, intent handling, text-to-speech and JSON Schema validation. Unreal remained authoritative over game state.
result: Improved qualitative dialogue quality from 3.89 to 8.92 out of 10 in evaluation.

title: Invoice Capture
goal: Reduce manual work in construction invoicing and document processing through a reliable B2B workflow.
action: Own the product architecture and implementation across Python, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Supabase, external APIs and AI-assisted document processing.
result: Designed an end-to-end workflow from invoice capture through validation and processing for a production product.

title: FPGA Racing
goal: Build a multiplayer racing game with physical hardware as a responsive game controller.
action: Developed the Unreal Engine 5 game in C++ and connected an FPGA accelerometer to the input system while implementing real-time gameplay and networking.
result: Delivered a playable Mario Kart-style multiplayer prototype with hardware-driven steering.

title: C Compiler
goal: Translate a meaningful subset of C source code into executable target output.
action: Implemented the compilation pipeline across lexical analysis, parsing, intermediate representation and code generation, with validation of compiler behaviour against test programs.
result: Produced a working end-to-end compiler and strengthened understanding of language tooling and systems software.

title: RISC-V CPU
goal: Turn an instruction-set specification into a functioning processor implementation.
action: Designed and implemented the CPU datapath and control behaviour from RISC-V requirements, applying digital-design and computer-architecture principles.
result: Delivered a working RISC-V CPU implementation and a practical understanding of instruction execution and hardware trade-offs.

title: Construction Management App
goal: Turn construction-team requirements into software workflows that support project coordination.
action: Designed and implemented application features around operational workflows, translating user needs into maintainable product behaviour.
result: Produced a usable full-stack foundation for construction project management and future workflow expansion.

title: Whiteboard Presenter
goal: Help a charity modernise its presentation workflow while upgrading from Windows 7 to Windows 11.
action: Designed and built the presentation and interaction workflow around the organisation's day-to-day needs, with attention to accessibility and reliable real-time behaviour.
result: Delivered a practical presenter tool that supported the charity's systems upgrade and ongoing use.
